name: Kalif
description: Kalif was a Xiytiar-class heavy transport belonging to the Imperials. Kalif was part of the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Corrupter's vital resupply convoy lead by the Nebulon-B Frigate Monitor to the Corrupter in the Mev system. Kalif cargo was "probe droids". The ship was then attacked by Rebel raiders and was destroyed.
